title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
lede: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the web's business models, squeezing aggregators that earn from ads and human traffic, much as search once displaced portals like Yahoo.

points: He expects revenue built on eyeballs and ads to give way to cost-per-click or more transactional models.
The shift could change which companies pay others for traffic and for transactions.
Asked about Amazon blocking shopping agents from its catalog, he suggested a rival such as Shopify could win by letting them in.
His summary: companies attached to one business model will have to scramble, because if they refuse the agent, someone else will accept it.

sections.text: For developers building shopping or browsing agents, access will hinge on business choices: some platforms block agents, and Nadella expects others to compete by welcoming them.
